prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preparing desktop workspace environment check..."]
1: ["Official Pet Adoption Identity Certificate", "Pet Name", "Official Companion Registered"]
2: ["Master Desktop Pet Controls", "Try dragging your pet or clicking the system tray icon to toggle visibility.", "Practice Pet Commands"]
3: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Select Starter Pet or Custom Creation"]
4: ["Important: Sign into your primary account to retain your existing pet profiles and data."]
5: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet", "Rendering pet graphics, configuring desktop placement, and preparing animations...", "Pet Generation Status"]
6: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Click and drag to move your pet around. Right-click or check the system tray icon anytime to hide or open settings.", "Start Playing"]
7: ["Select Your Desktop Pet Friend"]
8: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion in 30 Seconds", "Choose a ready-to-play pet or design your own unique companion.", "Adopt Now", "Instant 30-Sec Setup Available"]
9: ["Play Sound On Completion"]
